Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add Confluence integration - Phase 1: Models and API Service

Implements the foundation for Confluence Cloud integration allowing users to
publish transcription documents (meeting minutes and requirements) directly
to their Confluence workspace.

Backend Changes:
- Add Confluence credentials to User model (email, encrypted API token, URL, default space)
- Add encryption/decryption methods for secure token storage using Fernet
- Add Confluence tracking fields to Transcription model (page_id, page_url, published_at)
- Create database migration for all new fields

Confluence Service:
- Complete ConfluenceService class for API interactions
- Authentication with email + API token (Basic Auth)
- Test connection functionality
- Get spaces and pages from Confluence
- Convert text to Confluence Storage Format (HTML)
- Search pages by title
- Create new pages with optional parent
- Update existing pages (new version)
- Smart publish_or_update_page (creates or updates based on existing)
- Add labels/tags to published pages

Security:
- API tokens encrypted at rest using cryptography.fernet
- Secure storage with user-specific encryption
- Token never exposed in logs or responses

Next Phase:
- UI for Confluence configuration in user profile
- Publish button and modal in transcription results
- Backend endpoints for publish operations
- Install cryptography dependency

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
